data.task: Run the registered contradiction checks on this evidence bundle: reconcile host logs with collector copies, correlate bulk transfers with the destination policy and sessions, and compare the linked session with badge presence. Return candid

data.preview:
# Case notes (scripted fixture)

Auditor returned 5 candidate(s); 3 incident allegation(s).

- [incident_allegation] local_log_removal on workstation (/var/log/auth.log): 3 cited record(s)
- [benign_explanation] retention_explained_absence on records (/var/log/records-app/access.log): 7 cited record(s)
- [benign_explanation] policy_consistent_transfer on records (10.20.0.45:873): 1 cited record(s)

finding.rationale: /home/rhaddad/Downloads/upd-4c2e.pkg (20,944,103 bytes, owner rhaddad) was written on workstation shortly before the non-approved transfer and matches its size; the records application logged a bulk export of 'patients_full' to this host.
assumptions: matching size and timing indicate the same object; content was not inspected
alternative_explanations: an unrelated file of similar size
verifier_notes: an object of matching size was written on this host shortly before a non-approved bulk transfer

finding.rationale: 20,949,303 bytes from records to 10.20.0.45:873. destination 10.20.0.45 is an approved bulk destination: stor-nas-01 (backup and log archive).
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

finding.technique_family: Host log lines removed (closest ATT&CK entry: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs)
finding.rationale: 1 line(s) of /var/log/auth.log on workstation were received by the collector but are absent from the host's own copy, after the host's retention boundary (2026-11-10T06:15:00+00:00, basis: capture_start) and bracketed by later local records. Retained line: 2026-11-10T12:38:28+00:00 ws-nurse-01 login[2297]: pam_unix(login:session): session opened for user rhaddad on tty1 (session 91) Session(s): workstation#91.
assumptions: the collector is not writable from the monitored host
the forwarder delivered the line before it disappeared locally
alternative_explanations: a local log-agent or filesystem fault dropped the line
an administrator edited the file without recording it
verifier_notes: 1 cited collector record(s) are absent from the local log after the host's retention boundary, bracketed by later local records

finding.rationale: 183 line(s) of /var/log/records-app/access.log on records exist only at the collector, and all of them predate the host's retention boundary at 2026-11-10T09:00:04+00:00 (log rotation). Their absence from the host is expected, not suspicious.
assumptions: the rotation record and the stated retention policy are accurate
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

finding.technique_family: Transfer to a non-approved destination (exfiltration mapping is context-dependent)
finding.rationale: 20,948,102 bytes left workstation for 10.20.9.87:8080 between 2026-11-10T12:41:24+00:00 and 2026-11-10T12:41:37+00:00. destination 10.20.9.87 is not on the approved bulk-destination list (10.20.0.45, 10.20.8.20). It overlaps exactly one session on workstation: workstation#91 (account rhaddad, console; login record seen in: collector copy).
assumptions: the supplied destination policy is complete and current
alternative_explanations: an approved destination missing from the supplied policy
verifier_notes: bulk transfer to a destination not on the approved list, cited via the flow record
